title: QUEST: Danish asylum-appeal credibility extraction + crels vs qrels (arXiv 2608.28555)
claim: arXiv 2608.28555 (cs.IR primary; on cs.IR/new Monday 2026-08-31 mailing; submitted 2026-08-28) introduces QUEST, a query/topic/extraction pipeline over Danish Refugee Appeals Board materials (pub 200 summaries / 4,028 chunks; priv 315 cases / 20,912 chunks) to surface credibility-assessment factors. Authors add crels — domain-specific relevance asking whether a chunk answers a topic by assessing credibility — distinct from ordinary qrels; Cohen's κ between qrels and crels is 0.04 (pub and 0.02 (priv). LLM-as-judge vs a human credibility expert is weak (κ 0.130 pub / −0.010 priv); the human is stricter. System is not deployed; ethics statement requires human-in-the-loop. Intersects legal IR + LLM-as-judge + schema-first factor extraction.
excerpt: We present the QUEST system (Query and Extraction System for Topics) to extract and identify factors relating to credibility assessments in two datasets of Danish asylum application appeals.
